name: openshift
description: OpenShift command-line tools for managing containerized applications on Red Hat OpenShift

tools.description: OpenShift CLI for managing applications, builds, deployments, and cluster resources
tools.usage:
oc login https://api.cluster.com # Login to cluster
oc new-app nodejs~https://github.com/user/app # Create new application
oc get pods # List running pods
oc logs deployment/myapp # View application logs
oc scale --replicas=3 deployment/myapp # Scale deployment
